moves.currentCritique: Strongest feature: Ferrer identifies the ontological presupposition inside Dillahunty's practical formula because desiring and believing something good cannot guarantee that the object really possesses moral value. Principal limitation: The reply successfully demands a truth condition but does not show that goodness must be a separately existing entity or that only a divine mind can satisfy the requirement. Live burden: He must demonstrate why objective relational facts about creatures consequences and flourishing cannot make evaluative beliefs correct and then establish divine grounding without merely defining goodness through God. Locked score: The locked score is 77 in the Competent band because the response exposes an important ambiguity between sincere moral belief and moral truth while stopping short of proving its exclusive metaphysical conclusion.

moves.lockedProposition: A non-reducible soul supplies leverage outside the allegedly circular material brain and supports the existence of a supernatural mind.
moves.completeLockedSourceExcerpt: I suggest Christian ethics offers a an improvement on this because we don't say the mind is reducible to the brain we allow a soulish element that can offer some leverage that isn't stuck in the same material circle material loop that all these brain problems are and conversely a supernatural mind exists so
moves.currentCritique: Strongest feature: Ferrer recognizes that his skeptical argument requires some proposed escape from material cognitive mediation and supplies a clearly identifiable nonreductive alternative rather than leaving the gap entirely empty. Principal limitation: Merely positing a soul neither establishes its existence nor explains its information access reliability calibration or immunity from the same self certification problem attributed to brains. Live burden: He must provide positive evidence for the soul and a detailed mechanism showing why its judgments track moral truth more reliably than embodied cognition and independent confirmation. Locked score: The locked score is 52 in the Developing band because the proposal contacts the relevant burden but functions primarily as an unsupported exception introduced to rescue the preceding skeptical argument.
